title: fetch_with_https_client is dead code duplicate of fetch_peer_blob_from_url test helper
description: peer_fetch.rs has two near-identical fetch implementations: fetch_with_https_client (production, lines 411-483) and fetch_peer_blob_from_url (test-only, lines 525-581). The test helper was written to avoid needing TLS in tests, but it replicates Content-Length check, Limited body collection, size check, and verify_and_store call. Any fix to the production path must also be applied to the test helper. Extract the shared logic into a generic helper parameterized on the client type, or find a way to share more code between the two paths.
